name: Cinturato Road (tube type)

origin.basis: Italian tire maker; Pirelli says the P ZERO Race range is made at its plant in Italy near its Milan headquarters.

manufacturing.basis: Pirelli says it was designed in its Bollate factory in Italy; the production location is not stated.

positioning: Protection-first tube-type tire for daily riding, with a 60 TPI TechWALL+ casing.
pressure_note: The product page gives no maximum pressure; use the figure printed on the tire.

wet_notes.summary: Pirelli claims the SmartNET Silica compound gives superior grip in all kinds of weather.

availability.note: Listed in Pirelli's UK catalogue with a dealer finder; mainland China and North American availability not verified for this line.

caveats: Bicycle Rolling Resistance's results for the earlier Cinturato Velo are not applied.
